description: LifeBeyondEarth Research Core built an interactive planetary outpost and bio-dome simulator for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 — Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer. Learners explore lunar and Martian environments, select crops, manage resources, run survival simulations and review Mission Reports. Built with React, TypeScript, Python and FastAPI, it combines public NASA data resources, simplified life-support models, robotic assistance and Mission Memory.
summary: LifeBeyondEarth Research Core is an interactive simulation platform exploring the challenges of sustaining human life beyond Earth. It brings together planetary habitat planning, bio-dome food production, energy management, mission operations and robotic support in one integrated experience. Users can explore how interconnected systems influence the survival and sustainability of a future planetary outpost. The project combines a web-based interface with a Python backend to demonstrate how simulation, data and decision-support tools can help people understand the complexity of long-duration space exploration. Its goal is to make planetary settlement challenges more accessible while encouraging systems thinking about the future of human exploration.
details:
LifeBeyondEarth Research Core is an interactive planetary outpost simulation designed to explore the interconnected challenges of sustaining human life beyond Earth.

The application combines a web-based interface with a Python and FastAPI backend. Its components explore planetary environments, habitat and survival planning, bio-dome food production, resource and energy management, mission operations, predictive analysis and robotic support.

Users can interact with the simulation to explore how decisions involving resources, environmental conditions and mission operations affect the sustainability of a planetary outpost.

The project was developed using React, TypeScript, Python and FastAPI, with supporting software libraries and development tools. AI-assisted tools were used during development for coding assistance and content preparation. Their use is disclosed in this submission.

The project is an educational simulation and decision-support prototype, not a certified life-support system or a validated prediction of an actual planetary mission.

The intended impact is to make the complexity of future planetary exploration more accessible and encourage systems thinking about sustainable human presence beyond Earth.

Source code: https://github.com/mandeep-iOS/LifeBeyondEarth
